# Cncf Talos Linux Reviewer

Review Talos Linux using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Distribution category. Talos Linux is a single purpose distribution for Kubernetes. It provides an API driven—no SSH—operating system to deploy vanilla Kubernetes anywhere.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
